answer_1.quote: D2D (i) identifies its topical domain, (ii) assigns each agent a concise domain profile, and (iii) orchestrates a five-stage debate comprising opening statements, rebuttals, free debate, closing statements, and judgment.
answer_1.outputs: Structured debate transcripts (opening, rebuttal, free debate, closing) plus multi‑dimensional scores and an authenticity verdict.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance using four standard metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Table presents the overall results of D2D, baselines and ablated variants on the two datasets.

answer_3.quote: The Judge Agents evaluate the debate along five independent dimensions, and generates both a binary authenticity judgment and a debate summary.
